Tooth Lock Washer

A washer with multiple teeth arranged on the inside (internal-tooth type) or outside (external-tooth type); when a bolt or nut is tightened, the tips of the teeth bite into the clamped surface to prevent loosening. The spec symbols follow KS B 1325, JIS B 1255, and we also carry special tooth-profile shapes (internal-tooth type) and double-layered combination types (internal + external tooth).
